$comment: REQ-KEYS-1 (226_R7SHELL.1a; RV-14) — the browser-safe keymap rules as data. Rule 1 (nonCapturable): chords a supported browser never delivers to the page. Rule 2 (conventionalAvoid): capturable but conventional chords the map must avoid. Rule 4 (keep): chords the spec keeps despite convention (⌘K palette, ⌘⏎ run sheet, ⌘S restore-point semantics). transitional: pre-existing conventional-avoid bindings grandfathered until 239_R7WRITE.2 completes the remap — each entry pins the chord to its ONE grandfathered action, so planting any other action on the chord fails the checker. `mod` = ⌘ on macOS / Ctrl elsewhere.
